title: SlimeVR bone override
description: Overrides selected properties of an existing bone. Definitions are resolved first, then overrides are applied in pack order before the resulting skeleton is validated. `set` merges where the bone schema declares a keyed map (`outputs` per output key, `emit` per address) and replaces whole everywhere deeper: a `value` pipeline or a `restRotation` list is always swapped atomically.

target.description: Key of the bone to override. Overrides cannot rename their target.

set.description: Property values to set on the target bone. `outputs` and the `emit` map inside each output entry merge per key. Every other property, and everything nested below those two merge points, is replaced atomically.

remove.description: Property paths to remove. Each path is an array of segments (e.g. ["outputs", "vmc"], or ["outputs", "vrchat", "emit", "/avatar/parameters/ToeLeft1Float"] to remove one message from that bone's emit map). Required identity and display properties cannot be removed.
